{{Quote|This is the ''Gravestone''! This was the only ship that ever went up against the Eternal Fleet and won. Do you have any idea how long people have been looking for this thing?|Koth Vortena|<ref name="Chapter 4" />}}
The '''''Gravestone''''' was a massive [[Alien/Legends|alien]] combat [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that was able to defeat the [[Eternal Fleet]], a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-controlled [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that was systematically destroying all life within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], with its powerful [[Omnicannon]]. The ''Gravestone'' disappeared after the [[Battle against the Eternal Fleet|battle]] with the fleet, scuttled in the [[Endless Swamp]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, it was discovered by the crew of [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], who repaired the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and used it to escape Zakuul. The ''Gravestone'' became the mobile base of the Outlander's group prior to the establishment of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] on [[Odessen]].

==History==
{{Quote|The ''Gravestone'' suffered minor hull damage. This would have been avoided had I been allowed full access to the mainframe.''"<br />"''Minor hull damage&hellip; or you commanding an unstoppable alien warship? Decisions, decisions.|SCORPIO and Koth Vortena|<ref name="Chapter 8" />}}
===Early history===
[[File:Gravestone_1.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Gravestone'' rises from the [[Endless Swamp]].]]
The ''Gravestone'' was a combat [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] built by a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] in the planet of [[Iokath]],<ref name="Chapter 4 ET">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=4}}</ref> [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ''Gravestone''{{'s}} powerful [[Omnicannon]] was capable of targeting an enemy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and spreading the damage to other nearby vessels, which proved incredibly useful against the [[Eternal Fleet]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Gravestone}}</ref>&mdash;a massive [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of unstoppable [[Warship/Legends|warships]] controlled by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that was decimating all life it encountered. In a [[Battle against the Eternal Fleet|massive battle]], the ''Gravestone'' defeated the Eternal Fleet and deactivated it, leaving the ships dormant somewhere in Wild Space.<ref name="Fleet Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Eternal Fleet}}</ref> The ''Gravestone'' was believed lost, though in actuality its builders scuttled the frigate and set it down in the [[Endless Swamp]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], where it remained for centuries.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

===Rediscovery===
[[File:Omnicannon.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Gravestone'' fires its omnicannon.]]
It was finally rediscovered by [[Koth Vortena]], [[Lana Beniko]], [[HK-55]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] after crashing in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] following a [[Rescue of the Outlander|rescue mission]] to free the Outlander from the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]]. The group repaired the vessel<ref name="Chapter 4" /> and managed to escape Zakuul in the ''Gravestone'', using the Omnicannon to punch a hole in the Eternal Fleet&mdash;now under the control of [[Arcann]], Emperor of the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="Chapter 5" /> The ''Gravestone'' managed to limp to the nearby [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Asylum]], where the ship was repaired and Vortena's old crew joined the vessel.<ref name="Chapter 6">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=6}}</ref>

[[File:Gravestone.png|thumb|250px|left|Damaged, the ''Gravestone'' arrives to Asylum for repairs.]]
The droid intelligence [[SCORPIO]] joined the Outlander's crew in order to speak with the ''Gravestone''{{'s}} central [[Computer/Legends|computer]], seeing it as an intelligence that rivaled her own; upon connecting with the ship, she was able to repair and revitalize many of its systems<ref name="Chapter 7">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=7}}</ref>&mdash;just in time to use them during the [[Battle of Asylum]], when the Outlander's crew escaped the Eternal Fleet's blockade and assault upon Asylum.<ref name="Chapter 8" /> The ''Gravestone'' traveled to the planet [[Odessen]], where it remained docked with the Outlander's fledgling [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] constructed [[Alliance base|base]] in the cliffs nearby.<ref name="Chapter 9" />

[[File:Gravestone_2.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Gravestone'' approaches a lone [[Eternal Fleet warship]].]]
The Alliance inner circle later took the ''Gravestone'' on a mission to seize an [[Eternal Fleet warship]] in hopes of using [[GEMINI Prime]] to take control of the whole network. The ''Gravestone'' kept the battlecruiser occupied as a boarding party, composed of the Outlander, Lana, [[Senya Tirall]], SCORPIO and [[Theron Shan]], managed to board the ship. However, the mission went south as the [[GEMINI]] captain broadcast a distress signal. After getting the boarding party, sans SCORPIO, along with two pods of prisoners, the ''Gravestone'' escaped into hyperspace as [[Eternal Flagship|Arcann's flagship]] and the Eternal Fleet arrived. While in hyperspace, the ''Gravestone'' received a transmission from SCORPIO, who had faked her destruction and had taken control of most of the Eternal Fleet.<ref name="Chapter 15">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=15}}</ref>

===The Battle of Odessen===
[[File:Gravestone_over_Odessen.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The ''Gravestone'' fires at the Eternal Fleet above Odessen.]]
The ''Gravestone'' later defended Odessen against Arcann after SCORPIO leaked its location. With Theron manning the omnicannon, the ''Gravestone'' fired two shots that destroyed a portion of Arcann's support ships, enabling the Outlander and a strike team to board and disable the [[Eternal Flagship]]'s weapons and shields. The omnicannon soon malfunctioned as SCORPIO attempted to remotely take control of the ship, but was shut out by Koth. Subsequently repairing the omnicannon, the ''Gravestone'' fired at the Flagship just as the Eternal Fleet grouped together to charge up a powerful energy attack, causing a massive explosion that destroyed the Flagship and the Fleet, saving the Alliance from annihilation.<ref name="Chapter 16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref>

===The Invasion of Voss===
The ''Gravestone'' later saw [[Invasion of Voss|action]] over the planet [[Voss]], defending the planet from being decimated by the Eternal Fleet, before the arrival of the Sith Empire drove off the enemy.<ref name="KOTETChapter 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>

===Return to Iokath===
[[File:Gravestone_on_the_hunt.jpg|thumb|250px|right|The ''Gravestone'' on the hunt for the Eternal Fleet.]]
The ''Gravestone'' later responded to a distress call from a cargo freighter called [[Ridala]], which was under attack by two Eternal Fleet ships. Koth allowed the Ridala to dock aboard the ship, unaware that it secretly contained Empress [[Vaylin]] and SCORPIO, who had taken advantage of the Outlander's apparent demise on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to seize the ''Gravestone''. Koth managed to remain at large while the rest of his crew were taken captive by Vaylin, and managed to send a distress call to Odessen. With the bridge controls and weapons locked by a special passcode of Koth's, preventing Vaylin and SCORPIO from taking control of the ship, the Empress interrogated his second, [[Len Parvek]], who revealed under torture that the passcode was based on Koth's war record on the soldiers who died under his command.<ref name="KOTETChapter 3">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=3}}</ref>

[[File:Gravestone_adrift.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Gravestone'' adrift in space.]]
As the Alliance fleet engaged the Eternal Fleet, the Outlander and Lana Beniko boarded the ''Gravestone'' to retake the ship. Koth then informed them that he had secretly placed a [[quantum bomb]] onboard the ship that would go off if SCORPIO unlocked the bridge control without his secondary passcode. The Outlander and Koth worked to disable three bomb fuses before heading to the bridge, finding the latter's crew left alone. A hologram of SCORPIO revealed she knew of the quantum bomb, as she wished to preserve the ''Gravestone'', and that Beniko was fighting Vaylin in the dark sanctum of the ship, where Koth hid the bomb. As the Outlander fought Vaylin, their fight accidentally set the bomb off on a three minute timer.<ref name="KOTETChapter 3" />

[[File:Gravestone_returns_to_Iokath.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Gravestone'' returns to Iokath.]]
Just as Vaylin had the advantage over her foe, Valkorion directly intervened, activating his daughter's mental conditioning with the phrase, "Kneel before the dragon of Zakuul", forcing the Empress to retreat. With the bomb about to go off, the Outlander destroyed any nearby power relays, allowing Koth to defuse the bomb. Soon after, Theron Shan brought a small Alliance squad with him aboard the ship. Unfortunately, with the ''Gravestone'' no longer in danger, SCORPIO, revealed to be operating under her own agenda, seized control of the ship and discovered the location of Iokath, to which she promptly set a course.<ref name="KOTETChapter 3" /> As the ''Gravestone'' entered Iokath's superstructure, the occupants were soon incapacitated by a planetary energy weapon fired by [[ARIES]], the only sentient droid caretaker of the planet, who then spread both the Outlander and Vaylin's crews across the planet to place in impossible "tests" to determine who was worthy of inheriting Iokath.<ref name="Chapter 4 ET" /> The ''Gravestone'' was then impounded at a fleet spire along with the Eternal Fleet.<ref name="KOTETChapter 5">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=5}}</ref>

[[File:Gravestone_returns_to_Odessen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Gravestone'' returns to Odessen after escaping Iokath.]]
Theron repeated attempted to scan for the ''Gravestone's'' location with no success before deciding to scan for his shuttle docked in its hanger. He then remotely piloted his shuttle to the Outlander's party's location and after dropping their leader off at ARIES' base, flew to the ''Gravestone''{{'s}} location. The ''Gravestone'' then returned to ARIES base to retrieve the Outlander and managed to escape Iokath before the energy weapon overloaded and flooded the planet with lethal radiation. Upon their return to Odessen, the Alliance got to work upgrading the ''Gravestone'' with datafiles recovered from Iokath to improve its combat abilities, rendering it inoperative for the time being.<ref name="KOTETChapter 3" />

===The Second Battle of Odessen===
[[File:Zildrog_hijacks_the_Gravestone.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Zildrog hijacks the ''Gravestone'' from the Alliance.]]
The new upgrades were nearly complete when Vaylin led a second [[Assault on Odessen|assault]] on Odessen. The Outlander, who had returned after chasing Vaylin to [[Nathema]], defended the ''Gravestone'', giving the crew enough time to finish the upgrades so the frigate could join the battle.

===The Battle of Zakuul===
Following Vaylin's defeat, The Outlander headed to Zakuul to seize the Eternal Throne. The ''Gravestone''{{'s}} omnicannon allowed the strike group to break the blockade around the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] and land on the surface of the planet.<ref name="KOTETChapter 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref>

===Nathema Conspiracy===
[[File:Gravestones_End.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The end of the ''Gravestone'']]
Upon the Alliance mission to [[Nathema]], the ''Gravestone'' was hijacked by [[Zildrog]] and used to destroy the Eternal Fleet. Afterword, it was poised to destroy Odessen, but was thankfully stopped after the Alliance Commander destroyed Zildrog, destroying the ''Gravestone'' and Eternal Fleet in the process.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Gravestone'' first appeared in [[BioWare]]'s [[2015]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] to its [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Chapter 4" />
